result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two pages are very close: both use soft off-white text on a near-black background, monospace right-aligned uptime figures and clear date/title/body stacks for incidents. B edges ahead because its uptime figures are brighter and easier to compare than A's dimmer gray numbers, and its incident text is held to a narrower, more comfortable line length. B also adds 'Operational' and 'Resolved' labels, which give it an extra level of metadata. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are very similar: dark gray backgrounds (not pure black), off-white text, monospace right-aligned uptime figures and well-structured incident entries. A has the edge because its incident body text is slightly larger and has more generous line spacing, and its percentages are brighter and easier to compare. B's uptime figures are a dimmer gray, though its uppercase section labels give it a slightly clearer metadata level.
